South Carolina Ballet's Dracula: Ballet With A Bite!
events.info: Get ready to be mesmerized by the allure of Count Dracula and his legion of vampire maidens as they take the Johnny Mercer Theater stage in South Carolina Ballet's Dracula: Ballet with a Bite! This wildly popular ballet promises an evening of haunting sensuality and thrilling entertainment. Created by CEO and Artistic Director William Starrett, this sizzling adaptation of Bram Stoker's classic novel blends seductive choreography with a hauntingly beautiful score, creating an unforgettable experience. Witness the mesmerizing Count Dracula and his sensual journey brought to life by the extraordinary talent of the South Carolina Ballet!

events.name: Mark Paul: The Daddy Ball Tour
events.info: Mark Paul, a renowned comedian and social media personality, is widely regarded as the original travel ball comedy sensation. His iconic baseball parents and coaching personas will leave you in stitches. Known for his humorous reels on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook, which are comedy gold. Mark s journey began five years ago after his daughter encouraged him to make a TikTok video. He took her advice and started a social media presence highlighting how parents interact with their kids, coaches, umpires, and each other in youth sports building a massive following. Recommended Audience is 13 years old and over. Parental Discretion advised.

events.name: Jurassic Quest – Savannah, GA | Savannah Convention Center
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure Is Here!
Jurassic Quest is bigger than ever, bringing together dinosaurs, prehistoric sea creatures, and Ice Age giants in one unforgettable experience.
🦕 Jurassic Quest – Walk among life-sized, moving dinosaurs including the mighty T. rex, towering Apatosaurus, and massive Spinosaurus. Dig for fossils, meet adorable baby dinos, and ride your favorite prehistoric giants.
🌊 Ancient Oceans – Dive beneath the surface and come face-to-face with incredible creatures that ruled the seas millions of years ago, including our jaw-dropping 53-foot Megalodon.
❄️ Frozen Frontier – Step into the Ice Age and encounter legendary creatures like the Woolly Mammoth and Saber-Toothed Cat as you explore a world frozen in time.
Plus enjoy interactive exhibits, hands-on activities, inflatables, rides, photo opportunities, and prehistoric fun for the whole family.
🎟️ One ticket gets you access to all three incredible experiences. Don't miss North America's largest prehistoric adventure — get your tickets before they go extinct! 🦖✨
